<div class="markdown-body NewMarkdownViewer-module__safe-html-box__ZT1eD">

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**

Animation loop is unnecessery when `OrbitControls.enableDamping = true`
in some three.js examples.

**Describe the solution you'd like**

Rendering on demand when `OrbitControls.enableDamping = true`.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**

It is not the best way to resolve damping animation;

<div class="highlight highlight-source-js notranslate position-relative overflow-auto"
dir="auto"
snippet-clipboard-copy-content="const controls = new OrbitControls( camera, renderer.domElement );

// animation need scene and renderer
controls.setScene( scene );
controls.setRenderer( renderer );

// Call damping animation when `orbitControls.enableDamping = true` in OrbitControls.update() function.">

``` notranslate
const controls = new OrbitControls( camera, renderer.domElement );

// animation need scene and renderer
controls.setScene( scene );
controls.setRenderer( renderer );

// Call damping animation when `orbitControls.enableDamping = true` in OrbitControls.update() function.
```

</div>

**Additional context**

<a href="https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/pull/23088"
class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title"
data-id="1088646111" data-permission-text="Title is private"

data-hovercard-url="/mrdoob/three.js/pull/23088/hovercard">#23088</a>

</div>

</div>
